prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1482; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pearland, in the right-hand lane, waiting to turn. I had been sitting there for maybe half a minute.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back, and my car was pushed into the intersection a few feet. The other driver was following too closely, I think.

Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?

A: Briefly. He said he didn't see the light change in time and he was sorry. He seemed shaken up too.

Q: Were you taken to a medical facility?

A: An ambulance came, but I declined the ride. I drove myself to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon because my right knee was swelling and I couldn't bend it properly.

Q: Can you describe the knee symptoms you have experienced since then?

A: It's sore when I walk, especially on stairs. It feels unstable at times, like it might give out. The swelling has gone down a little, but I still limp by the end of the day.

Q: Have you received any treatment or referrals since the urgent care visit?

A: I was referred to an orthopedic specialist and I have a follow-up scheduled. They ordered an imaging study, and I'm waiting on the results.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my car and my knee looked at properly. Thank you for listening.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this recorded statement.
